title: DrWrinch Shiny app: implementation plan
text: real choices. recommendation trade-. Decision — Plot library: ggplot2 vs. plotly. - Recommendation: ggplot2. ’s already Suggests. plots small, static, need look right screenshot; plotly’s interactivity (hover, zoom) nice--, need-- . Adding plotly means another heavy dependency bloats shinyapps.io image size slows cold-start. - Trade-: ggplot2 give hover-tooltips omega curve. Mitigation: print numeric omega_star clear annotation plot. later want interactivity, swap plotly one helper change. Decision B — Tab vs. accordion vs. side--side two models. - Recommendation: side--side cards single screen, sharing one set inputs. whole point vignette usually want BFs reported together (“doubt, compute ”). Forcing user flip tab compare binomial-vs-urn defeats . - Trade-: narrow screens stacks; fine bslib::layout_columns(col_widths = c(6,6)) auto-collapses. - Alternative prefer: radioButtons("model", ...) one card. — hides comparison. Decision C — theta_cut prior_a, prior_b exposed? - Recommendation: hide theta_cut, prior_a, prior_b behind collapsible “Advanced” bslib::accordion_panel. target audience know . Default theta_cut =   0.5, prior_a = prior_b = 1. Power users open accordion. - Trade-: discoverability prior-sweep sensitivity feature. Mitigation: “Sensitivity” tab text describes M_star (“M extra pseudo-observations favoring rival”) plain prose regardless whether prior accordion open. Decision D — app support urn model’s domain restriction gracefully? - Yes, mandatory. bf_urn(2, 10) returns NA_real_. server must detect render clear “urn model undefined rival-favorable urn supply sample size n = y_W + y_R y_R > y_W + 1” message urn card, still showing binomial result. exactly kind friction drives non-R users away handled. Decision E — Single shinyapps.io account vs. team. - plan author decide . rsconnect::accounts() returns one jwbowers already, deploy . Otherwise user needs register https://shinyapps.io run rsconnect::setAccountInfo(). Flag deploy step. Decision F — CRAN submission timing. - plan author recommends submitting current 0.0.0.9002 (four core functions, clean check) first, adding run_app() 0.0.1 afterward. Cleaner first submission; deploy script depends CRAN binary existing.

what: Fully Specified Bayes Factors for Process Tracing
title: Fully Specified Bayes Factors for Process Tracing
text: Fully specified Bayes factors process tracing. package implements methods Lopez, Bowers, Gajardo Cooper (2026), “Fully specified Bayes factors process tracing” (arXiv:2606.16683). Two generative models evidence favor working theory single rival — binomial model open-ended evidence hypergeometric urn model bounded archives — yield conservative Bayes factor. Sensitivity analyses vary coding error, observation bias, prior. package named Dorothy Maud Wrinch (1894–1976), mathematician whose joint papers Harold Jeffreys (1919, 1921, 1923) developed framework became Jeffreys’s theory Bayes factors. companion package, DrBristol, implements p-value methods class problems.
